A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] '''hunter''' joined a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] party to capture wild [[maramu]]s on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] at the behest of his [[King/Legends|King]], [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]]. The Dulok and his fellows were ambushed and forced to flee by an entity known to them as the Red Ghost&mdash;in reality, the wild [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Asha/Legends|Asha]]. The Dulok was distinguished from others of his [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] by a white cloth tied around his left arm and by a tuft of long, [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] on his chest.

==Behind the scenes==
The Dulok appears in the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] episode [[Asha (episode)|''Asha'']] as well as its adaptations. Several sources mention the Ewok Asha and the Dulok hunting party she bested.
